definitions: Amounts of money set aside or paid in advance to cover future expenses or obligations, often in the context of benefits, insurance, or escrow accounts.
Funds that have been contributed or deposited into an account before they are actually needed, creating a reserve.
examples: The company maintains significant prefund balances for employee pensions.
Managing prefund balances effectively can improve financial stability.
Auditors reviewed the prefund balances to ensure compliance.
